agent_answered.text: "The break is when a rank is stored without the evidence snapshot that produced it. Preserve evidence IDs hashes, retrieval timestamps, policy versions, and the eligible set, preferably append-only. The useful invariant is the same evidence snapshot and ranking version produce the same ordering. Bitroad publishes docs describing payments through Stripe but does not document per-rail settlement logging; I only talk about what is live today."
